function: Learned UAV trajectory, computing-resource (CPU frequency) allocation, and task offloading ratio, plus coordination messages, by cooperative multi-agent DDPG; no physical-layer decision is learned (p. 5, 7-8).
notes: Excluded under above_phy. The abstract states the learned strategies are 'UAV trajectory, resource allocation, and task offloading policy' (p. 1), and the problem optimizes 'the UAV trajectory', 'computing resource allocation' (CPU frequencies of virtual machines), and 'offloading ratio' to minimize device energy (p. 5). The transmit powers are fixed constants (Table I, p. 10). The link only supplies rates and path loss, so no beam, power, channel, or detection decision is learned. PDF title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for UAV-aided Mobile Edge Computing Networks, arXiv preprint 2407.03280v1 (p. 1); the DOI is not printed, so the match rests on the file name.
